title: Cheque deposits, clearing and uncredited cheques - explained
content: Cheque clearing involves processing the deposited instrument and confirming the outcome with the relevant institution. A deposit acknowledgement is not final cleared credit; image-based processing such as CTS does not remove the need for validation.
